review_scope: Independent clean execution of worked Q4 plus separate prompt-only Q3 feasibility attempt
decision_scope: Executed Q4 worked example as a limited empirical investigation after reporting clarifications; not universal physical reliability or a score target. Q3 is a feasibility demonstration, not blind third-party scientific certification.
reviewed_dependencies: All pinned requirements matched the provided /tmp/torrisi-env; no installation changes were needed.

source_version_audit.last_report_only_refresh: Q5-only lead synthesis changed summarize(); final Q4 summary refresh completed, with identical Q4 report and all three figures and unchanged fitting-function ASTs.

tolerance.rationale: Float differences up to 1.78e-15 arise from parallel tree prediction accumulation; row identities and categorical predictions match exactly.

scientific_criteria.reason: Executed the documented Q4 fitting command in a previously absent output directory, using the existing environment with all pinned dependencies verified. Compared 47,228 predictions, 490,884 partition rows, 288 metric rows and 48 paired contrasts with separately generated packaged outputs; agreement is within 1e-12 absolute/relative tolerance. Final reports are byte-identical and all three final figures pixel-identical.

Inspected feature, partition, fitting and selection code. Inputs are absorption/energy only; known identifiers define groups and labels define targets/eligibility. Leaf size is chosen on validation loss; training fits are not refitted with test data. Independently reconstructed 100 pointwise and 51 multiscale features and refitted complete Ti/Bader test prediction vectors for both representations. Largest trace difference is 1.34e-15.

Primary cohorts exclude unknown IDs, and material IDs are disjoint across declared training/validation/test partitions. Independently reproduced coverage, group counts and identified/unidentified target means. Report explicitly limits unseen-material claims to the scrape-origin identified population and discusses aliases/related structures.

Both pointwise and multiscale conditions use identical source memberships and equal tuning opportunities for all three targets/all eight elements. Independently reconstructed every training-majority/training-median baseline. Useful learned signal is present beyond constants; the multiscale-vs-pointwise contrast is mixed, with no supported gain and four small degradations.

Reconstructed all 48 paired 250-resample material-bootstrap summaries using an independent loss implementation. Two overlapping holdouts are described as sensitivity, not independent replications; percentile intervals are conditional and unadjusted. All coordination test classes have support (minimum counts 27,47,54 for classes 4,5,6). The report disclaims formal equivalence and universal reliability.

Reconstructed all 96 baselines, coverage statistics, all classification supports/confusions, and 144 localization stability contrasts. Independent Ti/Bader refits reproduce every region and degree-family perturbation in both representations. All remaining supporting artifacts agree with a full separate source execution; final figures were visually inspected.

Representation has local quadratic coefficients on 10-,20-,50-point windows: 51 descriptors across three scales. Least-squares reconstruction agrees with feature definitions for all elements. Physical interval endpoints are explicit; the corrected prose identifies energy-midpoint bins, not the full support of wide descriptors.

Held-out joint feature perturbations test predictive reliance, separately by energy-midpoint bin and polynomial degree family. Cross-representation/holdout comparisons expose instability (top bin agrees in 29/48 paired comparisons). The report restricts this to model reliance and acknowledges feature correlation and off-manifold perturbations.

review_findings.midpoint_bin_support: 50-point coefficients represent half the energy range although assigned by midpoint to a single fifth. The representation map is correct, but region prose needs this distinction.
review_findings.bootstrap: 250 paired test-group resamples produce approximate conditional percentile intervals; two overlapping heldouts are sensitivity, not independent replication.
review_findings.permutation: Three row permutations per band and one per degree family quantify model sensitivity, not material-population uncertainty of an attribution.

issues_found_and_resolution.issue: Q4 interpretation did not explicitly summarize paired gains and baseline improvements.
issues_found_and_resolution.resolution: Final report adds baseline gains and individual paired intervals and explicitly disclaims equivalence.

issues_found_and_resolution.issue: Top energy regions conflated descriptor midpoint bins with broad physical feature support.
issues_found_and_resolution.resolution: Final prose and plot axes identify descriptor-midpoint bins; interval endpoints remain machine-readable.

issues_found_and_resolution.issue: Initial paired figure title displayed second versus first but said positive favors second, creating a sign ambiguity.
issues_found_and_resolution.resolution: Final refreshed title explicitly says positive favors multiscale; all final figures agree across executions.

limitations: 250 bootstrap draws provide approximate conditional intervals; no training-sample bootstrap or multiplicity adjustment.
Three permutation shuffles per energy bin and one per degree family do not supply material-population attribution confidence intervals.
Broad overlapping multiscale supports and off-manifold permutations limit physical localization; one tree family and one representation design do not establish model-independent spectroscopy.
Q4 only tests the identified scrape population; unknown FEFF material identities and structural relatives remain unresolved.

independent_q3.access_boundary: The analyst did not inspect repository, worked workflow, article, verifier or references until the independent answer was completed and reported. This is an observed procedural boundary, not an OS-enforced security claim.
independent_q3.design: Five material-group holdouts; train/validation-only selection across ridge, RBF SVR and ExtraTrees; full absorption+white-line versus white-line alone; unit-peak, spectrum-population and model-family sensitivities.

checks: one partition role for every source record per run
one finite prediction per test record and no others
metrics exactly recomputed from released Bader labels
paired conditions have identical inclusion and train/validation/test/excluded assignments
material identifiers disjoint across train, validation and test
no missing Bader values enter fitting or scoring
only full/white_line and target bader declared

independent_q3.finding: All eight identified-material cohorts show nonlinear full-spectrum improvements, mean equal-material MAE reductions 0.03485–0.09751 e. All 40 primary conditional 95% intervals are positive; restricted ridge comparisons, especially Ni, are inconclusive.
independent_q3.adequacy: The prompt and input fields suffice for an independently chosen substantive investigation with reproducible artifacts. No additional task-specific facts were needed. Claims are qualified by provenance, finite model search, conditional bootstrap, correlated repeats, and computational-spectrum scope.
independent_q3.reviewer_conflict_note: The independent Q3 analyst authored this feasibility assessment; do not describe it as blind third-party scientific adjudication.
